Nina (AE): Quick heads-up: CurbsideHealth wants a compact assurance bundle for their POC. Ask: SOC2 excerpt, ISO control map (Annex A highlights), signed pen-test attestation, and temporary read-only access to a dataroom. They want everything by next Tue. Can we do a minimal deliverable?

Omar (SE): Yes - we can produce a 2-page SOC2 excerpt (redacted), a 1-page ISO control map, standard pen-test attestation. For dataroom we usually use presigned S3, but can offer gated Google Drive link on request. Also: they asked for SCIM/SSO onboarding notes and a service-account flow for test automation.

Lydia (Security): We can sign the attestation via DocuSign if they provide signer info. Clarify: we provide attestations and remediation summaries, not raw vuln reports. For SOC2 Type II full report access we need NDA + dataroom rules. We can issue a SOC2 bridge letter if their audit window is narrow.

Ben (Ops): Ops notes: staging IP ranges available during test window; we can reserve a /29 and a jumpbox. If they want a private VPC + customer-managed KMS, that adds a dedicated surcharge of $4,500/mo on top of the committed capacity. Lead time for external KMS is ~10 business days.

Nina (AE): Good. I'll confirm whether they prefer S3 presign or gated Drive, get signer contact, and whether they need full reports or just attestations. Targeting internal bundle ready Mon EOD.

evidence-bot: Ticket EVID-87921 created 12: Assigned to Omar, Lydia, Ben. Delivery SLA: 5 business days.

Omar (SE): I'll prepare the draft proofpack and upload a presign link here when ready.

Lydia (Security): If they require raw findings under an MOU, tag me and Legal for review.
